target: harvestFreshMassG (g fresh mass per pillow, as published in `Total (g)`)

armComparison.note: The flight target embeds crew consumption and a subsample mean; the ground target is a complete harvest plus broken leaves. A mean difference between arms therefore cannot be attributed to the space environment. See docs/phase6/osd655_mass_audit.json.

groundArmOnly.note: n=6 with 6 distinct pillows, so a grouped 4-fold CV would place one pillow per fold and cannot estimate a learning curve. No model is fit to this arm; the count is reported so the gap is explicit.

uncertainty.verdict: With 14 points in 10 groups, conformal coverage cannot be estimated reliably and falls below nominal. The interval is therefore reported as an UNCALIBRATED DESCRIPTIVE RANGE, not a confidence interval.

verdict: Retained as `baseline-only`. The regularised model does not beat the mean baseline on MAE or R2, the target is defined by two different formulas across arms, one arm has no leaf counts, and intervals cannot be calibrated at n=14. Reporting this as a yield predictor would be unsupportable.
